text:
Anna: Quick pulse — we need a lightweight accreditation path for new SI partners that can be finished in a week. goal: QA'd labs + a badge they can show in marketplace listing.
Devon: +1. Do we want self-paced labs or live cohorts?
Marco: Lean toward self-paced for v1, with optional weekly office hours. lowers ops burden.
Keisha: Agree. Also important: make the labs cloud-agnostic (AWS/GCP/Azure) but include one vendor-specific quickstart for infra partners.
Anna: Good call. We should also require a one-hour practical exercise in the labs that verifies they can deploy a Redwood Private demo in a VPC. not just a quiz.
Devon: For the practical: we can provide a terraform snippet + a tiny checklist. e.g. ```terraform
module "redwood_demo" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/example-onramp.git"
  region = var.region
}
```
Marco: I'll author the lab flow: intro -> infra prep -> deploy -> run test prompts -> verify metrics in console -> submit screenshot. Keep it under 90 minutes.
Keisha: How do we gate the badge? automated pass/fail after submission? or manual review?
Anna: Automated first-pass (smoke tests + screenshot checks), then random manual audits for 10% of submissions. we want scale but maintain quality.
onboard-bot: New draft lab "SI Onramp: VPC Quickstart" created by Marco. Link: https://internal.redwood/sig-labs/vpc-onramp
Devon: Nice. For the marketplace badge metadata, we need: badge name, icon, short description (max 140 chars), and attestation fields. I'll draft a schema.
Marco: Drafted the lab runbook and the smoke tests. uploading to the link now. ping me if you want early review.
Keisha: Training content ask: 2x 30-min workshops for sellers/solution architects — one high-level value props, one hands-on with the lab. who runs them?
Anna: Solutions engineering + partnerships should co-run. Devon can lead hands-on, Marco handles lab ops.
Devon: I'll take the hands-on sessions. Suggested dates: week of May 5.
Anna: Add calendar invite and a sign-up sheet. We'll push an invite to the SI pilot cohort list.
Marco: Also proposing a lightweight certification token (JWT) that contains: partner_id, lab_id, completion_ts, and signature. We can surface that in marketplace metadata for verification.
Keisha: Love that. Security check: ensure tokens expire and are revokable if a partner falls out of compliance.
Anna: Action items: Marco = finalize lab + smoke tests by Fri (2019876600), Devon = schema for badge + runbook for workshops by Mon (2019876580), Keisha = marketplace metadata + revocation plan by Tue. I'll track in the partner ops sheet.
Devon: I'll also create a short promo blurb for partner onboarding emails. 2 lines.
Marco: lab updated and test vector added. sample test prompt: "summarize the sample dataset in 3 bullets" and a token usage check.
Anna: Great. Follow-up sync Friday 11am. If anyone hits roadblocks ping me here. :thumbsup:
Keisha: Thanks — excited to roll this out.
Devon: On it.
Anna: Closing thread for now, we have owners. :white_check_mark:
